## Analysis

The annealing run improved C from 1.059793 to 1.073430, so structural mutation is validated, but broad restarts still leave a large gap to 1.144887. The winning set remained at n=17 and compressed to span 33 despite searching `[0,127]`, indicating that dense, collision-rich configurations are more promising than large-span exploration. Its sums and differences both increased, but sums gained proportionally more; future search should optimize exact C directly near this basin. The fixed linear cooling and restart budget likely prevented thorough local refinement.

## Next

Canonicalize each candidate by translation and gcd, use tabu tenure 50, deterministic seed 5, and checkpoint every improvement.
